The single discrepancy (off-by-one line citation for the HANDOFF-finetune link) is cosmetic and does not affect the report's utility to the dependent node. Lane-1 indeterminate statuses on the evidence-cited criterion are noted but my independent verification of the citations supersedes that uncertainty for integrity purposes.
